# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c36 P19](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0019), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** rose-red girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel Colby is a striking, dark-eyed young woman known as the "rose-red" girl. During her time at the Academy, she won the beauty prize among the Second Year classes.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a heart brimming with yearning dreams and imaginations that are as light and multicolored as Nell Harcourt's. She is considered by Nell to be exceptionally precious and beloved, second only to Isolde.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)_

## Traits

- contemplative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- creative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- driven  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Mabel Colby attended the Academy, where she became part of a small group of contemplative, creative, and driven scholars alongside Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis. During her Second Year at the Academy, she was awarded the beauty prize. Flossie Tulk once spread word to Isolde that Nell had become completely taken with Mabel, causing a brief moment of reproach from Isolde until Nell clarified her deep affection for both of them.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P19](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0019), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)_
